name: Sprint planning
description: Record a sprint's goals and committed items in Notion with their owners, keep a copy in Google Drive, and announce the plan to the team.

fields.label: Sprint goals
fields.help: What the team wants to achieve this sprint.

fields.label: Committed items
fields.help: One per line, ideally with an owner and a due date.

example.goals: Ship the onboarding checklist. Cut page load time by a quarter.
example.committed_items:
- Priya: build the onboarding checklist screen, due Wednesday.
- Sam: add image caching to the dashboard, due Thursday.
- Alex: write the release notes, due next Monday.
